findings.message: Misattributed NCP SLO (carries run-1 F1, which is otherwise repaired). docs/semester-4/efpg-402/unit-02/topic-03.mdx:54 states that in Grade 8 pupils explain that living organisms have a "complex transport system" and cites S-08-A-14. In the published NCP Science progression grid that outcome is S-07-A-15 (Grade 7); S-08-A-14 is "Identify the three major parts of the brain - cerebrum, cerebellum, the fore brain, mid brain and hind brain". Wrong code and wrong grade, presented as an exact reference. Repair: cite S-07-A-15 and Grade 7, or substitute a real Grade 8 life-sciences SLO.

Invented NCP quotation. docs/semester-4/efpg-402/unit-02/topic-04.mdx:46 writes "If the NCP asks pupils to 'plan a fair test with one variable changed'". The full 74-page NCP Science PDF names "fair test" only as one of the five scientific-enquiry types and never uses the word "variable". Same class as the run-1 fabricated quotations. Repair: remove the quotation marks and reframe it as the unit's own example, or bind the real SLO wording.

Render and print inspection (desktop, 360px narrow, table scrolling, A4 print, figure clipping) could not be performed. deployed SHA b7b7e00c9a8640158b8d336ba1215e4fcfed01e9 differs from HEAD b2dc2715255b31026bf257e58e451ecbf983d001 on the four repaired unit files and the four fig-U2-3 SVGs, so the production build is not the reviewed input; the crew brief prohibits a local build, dev server or Playwright run. Accessibility is unverified rather than passed.

docs/semester-4/efpg-402/unit-02/topic-03.mdx:48 quotes Bruner (1960) as "any subject can be taught in some intellectually honest form to any child at any stage of development". The canonical wording, bound at specs/content/efmp-301/sources/texts/seifert2009.md:112 and :373, is "any subject can be taught effectively in some intellectually honest form...". Restore "effectively" or paraphrase without quotation marks.
